text: まけると　かなしく　なるよ

patterns.name: 〜と (whenever)
patterns.explanation: と after the plain form of a verb means 'whenever this happens, that always follows'. まけると = 'whenever I lose'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: Changing the い of a describing word to く and adding なる means 'become' that way. かなしく　なる = 'become sad'.
